Interface Board

All Known Implementing Classes:
SimpleBoard
public interface Board
Represents the game board for the brick-dropping game. This interface defines all actions related to brick movement, rotation, board updates, and score handling.

    • holdBrick

      HoldShapeInfo holdBrick()
      Holds the current brick and swaps it with the held brick (if any). Can only be called once per piece until a new piece is spawned.
      Returns:
      HoldShapeInfo containing the held brick's shape and color, or null if hold was already used for this piece
